mcu-panel.panel.the-animation-library-co.note: Notice in the Animations tab when the list of saved animations cannot be fetched. A Try again button follows.

mcu-panel.panel.the-animation-studio-cou.text: The animation studio could not be loaded. It ships with Magic Card as {file}: update Magic Card to a version that includes it.
mcu-panel.panel.the-animation-studio-cou.note: Notice in the Animations tab when the studio file is missing from Magic Card. {file} is the name of that file.

vars.file: The value that replaces file in the text.

mcu-panel.panel.the-editor-files-could-n.text: The editor files could not be loaded from Magic Card. Reload the page and try again.
mcu-panel.panel.the-editor-files-could-n.note: Notice in the Icons, Shapes and Images tabs when the editor files from Magic Card fail to load.

mcu-panel.panel.the-forum-shot-could-not.text: The forum shot could not be loaded. It ships with Magic Card as {file}: update Magic Card to {version} or newer.
mcu-panel.panel.the-forum-shot-could-not.note: Notice in the Forum shot tab when the forum shot file is missing or will not load. {file} is the name of that file, {version} the lowest Magic Card version that has it.

vars.file: The value that replaces file in the text.
vars.version: The value that replaces version in the text.

mcu-panel.panel.the-forum-shot-needs-mag.text: The forum shot needs Magic Card {version} or newer. Update Magic Card.
mcu-panel.panel.the-forum-shot-needs-mag.note: Notice in the Forum shot tab when the installed Magic Card is too old or does not work with this panel. {version} is the lowest Magic Card version that has the forum shot.

vars.version: The value that replaces version in the text.

mcu-panel.panel.the-magic-card-editor-co.text: The Magic Card editor could not be loaded.
mcu-panel.panel.the-magic-card-editor-co.note: Notice in the template editor when the Magic Card card editor fails to load.

mcu-panel.panel.the-template-could-not-b.text: The template could not be saved.
mcu-panel.panel.the-template-could-not-b.note: Error in the template editor when saving fails and the server gave no reason.

mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-could-not-be-d.text: The theme could not be deleted.
mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-could-not-be-d.note: Error above the theme list when deleting a theme fails.

mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-could-not-be-e.text: The theme could not be exported.
mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-could-not-be-e.note: Error above the theme list when exporting a theme fails.

mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-editor-could-n.text: The theme editor could not be loaded. It ships with Magic Card as {file}: update Magic Card to {version} or newer.
mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-editor-could-n.note: Notice in the Themes tab when the theme editor file is missing. {file} is the name of that file, {version} the lowest Magic Card version that has it.

vars.file: The value that replaces file in the text.
vars.version: The value that replaces version in the text.

mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-list-could-not.text: The theme list could not be loaded.
mcu-panel.panel.the-theme-list-could-not.note: Error above the theme list when the list of theme files cannot be read.

mcu-panel.panel.theme.note: Type shown under the name of the selected theme and heading of its details group.

mcu-panel.panel.themes.note: Label of the Themes tab in the panel tab bar.

mcu-panel.panel.this-magic-card-utils-ve.text: This Magic Card Utils version doesn't match the theme editor in Magic Card. Update both to their latest versions.
mcu-panel.panel.this-magic-card-utils-ve.note: Notice in the Themes tab when the theme editor and this panel are from versions that do not work together.

mcu-panel.panel.this-template-is-still-l.text: {n, plural, one {This template is still linked to # card and cannot be deleted. Remove the bindings first.} other {This template is still linked to # cards and cannot be deleted. Remove the bindings first.}}
mcu-panel.panel.this-template-is-still-l.note: Message in the delete window when cards still use the template. {n} is the number of those cards.

vars.n: The count the text is about.

mcu-panel.panel.this-theme-is-read-only-.text: This theme is read-only. Open it in the studio and save a copy to edit it.
mcu-panel.panel.this-theme-is-read-only-.note: Note in the theme details for a theme file that cannot be changed from the panel.

mcu-panel.panel.try-again.note: Button under a load error in the Animations, Themes, Library, Shapes, Images and Icons tabs that tries the load again.

mcu-panel.panel.updated-date.note: Part of the second line of a template row: when the template last changed. {date} is a formatted date.

mcu-panel.panel.variables.note: Label of the field that shows how many variables a theme sets.

mcu-panel.panel.view.note: Column header of the card list: the view (tab) of the dashboard a card is on.

mcu-panel.panel.view-box-w-h.note: Caption under the item preview in the inspector. {w} and {h} are the width and height of the SVG view box.
